findings.Quote: He read it twice, then a third time, waiting for the numbers to disagree with each other. They didn't.
findings.Note: Slightly overworked beat of disbelief-checking that borders on a stock thriller tic (rereading orders to confirm horror); the repetition of 'twice/third time' plus 'waiting for numbers to disagree' is a familiar tension-mechanic rather than a fresh rendering of Tavi's precision-first characterization.
findings.Fix: Trim to a single confirming re-check consistent with his established economy of action.

findings.Quote: the floor seemed to shift — not really, but that was the feeling of it, the floor moving out from under him faster than he could plant his feet
findings.Note: The 'floor tilting' sensation is the exact stock metaphor named in the beat's purpose, presented almost literally and then hedged, which weakens rather than renders it fresh.
findings.Fix: Replace with a concrete physical detail specific to Reza (grip, breath, pulse) rather than the floor-tilt image.

findings.Quote: A route so exact it almost looked like luck.
findings.Note: The purpose calls for agonized near-miss tension between two people trying to spare each other; this line frames the routing as competent craft/luck rather than dramatizing the cost or dread of the convergence.
findings.Fix: Replace with a beat that surfaces Tavi's unease at how neatly the route avoids Reza, deepening dread instead of admiring the skill.

findings.Quote: his face unreadable the whole way in
findings.Fix: replace with a specific physical detail Tavi actually reads and misreads

findings.Quote: the kind of place with a working Substrate seam overhead and a menu in four languages nobody in the room spoke
findings.Note: minor filler-wit aside, more Tavi-beat texture bleeding awkwardly, but this is actually ref 1 — flagging misplacement check not needed; within ref 0 no such line exists
findings.Fix: n/a

findings.Quote: He had not thought about Tavi in a long time. He left it there.
findings.Note: Purpose calls for this beat but the line is flat statement rather than felt absence; slightly undercuts the 'faintly hollow' texture the purpose wants by simply asserting rather than dramatizing the not-thinking.
findings.Fix: Let a concrete sensory trigger almost surface the memory before he suppresses it, so the suppression is shown, not just stated.

findings.Quote: He'd worked alone for fourteen months. It had taken him about that long to stop planning around a partner and start planning around no one.
findings.Note: Tells the emotional throughline (solitude as adaptation) rather than letting the preceding concrete details (rig fitted to his frame, ordering nothing) carry it; slightly redundant summary after the beat already showed the same idea.
findings.Fix: Cut the second sentence or fold it into a single concrete image instead of narrated conclusion.

findings.Quote: with hands steadier than they had any right to be
findings.Fix: Replace with a concrete physical detail specific to Rafi's action.

findings.Quote: Say the name and it became a problem he had to solve. Leave it unsaid and it stayed a door he had to hold.
findings.Note: Neat aphoristic parallelism that states the theme rather than dramatizing it — reads as authorial commentary.
findings.Fix: Cut or fold into action/sensation rather than stated maxim.

findings.Quote: It felt like safety. It kept feeling like safety right up until it turned into a door that only opened one way.
findings.Note: Aphoristic summary of theme stated directly to reader, telling rather than showing Tavi's recognition.
findings.Fix: Cut the second sentence or replace with a concrete image tying to Rafi's specific situation.

findings.Quote: the stillness of someone who's already counted the exits
findings.Note: Stock tough-kid characterization shorthand, seen often in genre fiction.
findings.Fix: Specify a physical tic unique to Rafi instead of the generic 'counted the exits' phrase.

findings.Quote: He'd told himself that was close enough.
findings.Note: Flat editorializing tag that undercuts tension by narrating Tavi's self-deception rather than letting the stale manifest speak for itself.
findings.Fix: Cut the sentence; let the four-month gap stand as unstated risk.

findings.Quote: It burned like a hole.
findings.Note: Generic pain-intensifier phrasing, close to stock wound description.
findings.Fix: Cut simile; describe the specific sensation (heat spreading, arm going numb at the edges) instead.

findings.Quote: twelve meters of corridor and whatever each man's hands knew about the other's
findings.Note: Vague poetic abstraction that tells rather than shows the specific tactical knowledge being invoked.
findings.Fix: Tighten to something concrete — what specifically their hands knew (a disarm, a strike pattern) rather than the vague poetic abstraction.

findings.Quote: his eyes went somewhere between forgiving and beaten and settled on neither
findings.Note: Names emotional states abstractly ('forgiving,' 'beaten') instead of rendering them physically; tells rather than shows.
findings.Fix: Replace with a concrete physical detail (where his eyes actually landed, what his mouth did) rather than naming emotional states abstractly.

findings.Quote: Killing Reza was not the same as winning.
findings.Note: Reads as a stated aphorism/thesis-line rather than an observed beat; slightly pulls toward pseudo-profundity.
findings.Fix: Cut the line or fold the realization into action/detail rather than statement.

findings.Quote: the only other thing to do was stop
findings.Note: Closing line reads as a mild universal-truth flourish rather than earned specific image, slightly softening the ambivalence the beat calls for.
findings.Fix: End on a concrete image (the ladder rung, the haze, his hands) instead of the abstracted binary statement.

findings.Quote: He felt the altitude drain out of him. Slow and complete.
findings.Note: The altitude-as-status metaphor is used well elsewhere in the piece, but 'drain out... slow and complete' tips into a stock deflation image.
findings.Fix: Ground it in one physical/specific detail instead of the abstract drain metaphor.

findings.Quote: The Φ0.40 lodged somewhere he'd feel later.
findings.Note: Vague placeholder for emotional cost — 'somewhere' avoids specificity the rest of the piece otherwise commits to.
findings.Fix: Name the specific location/sensation or cut the sentence.

findings.Quote: the world had felt like it was opening instead of closing
findings.Fix: cut the abstraction or replace with a concrete sensory memory of that morning

findings.Quote: It wasn't agreement. It was the nod of a man confirming a thing he already knew was true.
findings.Fix: cut the second sentence, which just restates the first without adding information

findings.Quote: Reza picked up Tavi's cup, looked at it, set it back down without drinking. Tavi let him.
findings.Fix: the gesture is ambiguous where the purpose calls for a clear anti-high-five beat; sharpen so the refusal/non-offer registers unmistakably as the inversion of the Heat coffee scene

findings.Quote: the ceramic level with the air now, past any pretending
findings.Fix: cut 'past any pretending' — abstract tag that tells rather than shows the cup's coldness/stillness

findings.Quote: the way you take a thing you've decided to believe in
findings.Fix: replace with a more specific, physical rendering of the kid's grip or posture

findings.Quote: Ozzie hadn't slept. So Ozzie already knew. By now everybody did.
findings.Fix: trim to one beat — the logical chain reads as filler exposition rather than observed detail
